description: This file defines a React component 'BookList' that displays a list of books with sorting and filtering capabilities. It includes methods for sorting by various properties, filtering based on search text, and rendering book details with interactive sorting icons.

classes.name: BookList
classes.description: React component for displaying and sorting a list of books based on various properties.

methods.name: filterBooks
methods.description: Filters the book list based on the search text.

methods.name: sortBooks
methods.description: Sorts the list of books according to current sorting configurations.

methods.name: sortBy
methods.description: Updates sorting configuration for a given property and triggers re-render.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the book list with headers, sorting icons, and book entries.
